Daily Quiz.question: ২) Bertrand Russel was a British
Daily Quiz.exp:
Bertrand Russell, in full name Bertrand Arthur William Russell. British philosopher, logician, and social reformer, founding figure in the analytic movement in Anglo-American philosophy, and recipient of the Nobel Prize for Literature in 1950. Daily Quiz.question: ৭) ”The Waste Land” is-
Daily Quiz.exp:
Thomas Stearns Eliot Wrote the poem The Waste Land.

The Waste Land
T.S Eliot

April is the cruellest month, breeding
Lilacs out of the dead land, mixing
Memory and desire, stirring
Dull roots with spring rain.
Winter kept us warm, covering
Earth in forgetful snow, feeding
A little life with dried tubers.
Summer surprised us, coming over the Starnbergersee
With a shower of rain; we stopped in the colonnade,
And went on in sunlight, into the Hofgarten,
And drank coffee, and talked for an hour.

Source: PoetryFoundation.com

Daily Quiz.question:
১৬) The blood-dimmed tide is loosed and everywhere
The ceremony of Innocence is drowned - Author of this line-
Daily Quiz.exp:
Those lines are extracted from The Second Coming by W.B Yeats.

The Second Coming
W.B Yeats

Turning and turning in the widening gyre
The falcon cannot hear the falconer;
Things fall apart; the centre cannot hold;
Mere anarchy is loosed upon the world,
The blood-dimmed tide is loosed, and everywhere
The ceremony of innocence is drowned;
The best lack all conviction, while the worst
Are full of passionate intensity.

Source: Poetryfoundation.com
